question: A product is marked at ₹7,500. Two successive discounts of 8% and 5% are offered. What is the final selling price?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Single equivalent discount % = X + Y − (X × Y)/100

Effective discount = 8 + 5 − (8 × 5)/100 = 13 − 0.4 = 12.6%

Selling Price = Marked Price × (100 − Effective Discount)%

Selling Price = 7500 × (100 − 12.6)/100 = 7500 × 87.4%

Selling Price = 7500 × 0.874 = 6555

**∴ The correct answer is ₹6,555.**
